title: State with useState Hook

theory.english: State is data that can change over time and when it changes, React automatically re-renders the component. The useState hook is the primary way to add state to a functional component. useState returns an array with two elements: the current state value and a setter function to update it. You must always use the setter function to update state — never mutate the state variable directly. When state changes, React re-renders only that component and its children. State is local and private to the component that owns it.
theory.hindi: State woh data hai jo time ke saath change ho sakta hai aur jab bhi yeh change hota hai, React automatically component ko re-render karta hai. useState hook functional component mein state add karne ka primary tarika hai. useState do elements wala array return karta hai: current state value aur use update karne ke liye ek setter function. State ko update karne ke liye hamesha setter function use karein — state variable ko directly kabhi mutate mat karein.
theory.hinglish: State woh data hai jo change hota hai over time. Jab state change hoti hai, React component ko re-render karta hai. useState hook se state add karte hain - yeh ek array return karta hai jisme current value aur setter function hota hai. Kabhi bhi state variable directly change mat karo - hamesha setter function use karo.

examples.title: Counter with useState
examples.explanation: useState(0) sets the initial value to 0. setCount updates the state, which triggers a re-render showing the new count value.

examples.title: Toggle State
examples.explanation: Using the functional form setIsOn(prev => !prev) is safer when the new state depends on the old state — it guarantees you get the latest value.

exercises.prompt: Create a LikeButton component that shows a like count and increments it when clicked.
exercises.expectedOutcome: A button with useState tracking the like count, re-rendering on each click.

exercises.prompt: Create a component with an input field that shows whatever the user types in real time below it.
exercises.expectedOutcome: A controlled input using useState, updating on every keystroke.

quiz.question: What does useState return?
options: An array with state value and setter function
quiz.explanation: useState returns an array: [currentStateValue, setterFunction]. We use array destructuring to name them.

quiz.question: What happens when you call the state setter function?
quiz.explanation: Calling the setter function updates state and triggers React to re-render the component with the new value.

quiz.question: What is the correct way to update state based on the previous value?
quiz.explanation: Using a function form setState(prev => prev + 1) guarantees access to the most recent state value.

summary: useState chapter complete! Aapne seekha state kya hoti hai, useState hook kaise use karte hain, aur state update karne ke safe tarike.
